description: Monero fee estimate per kB, split into ascending priority tiers, read from our own monerod. When to use: pricing an XMR transaction, or deciding whether to pay the baseline fee to land in the next block. Do not use: for Bitcoin fees (btc_get_fee_rates) or for mempool depth (xmr_get_mempool_state). Returns: baseline_fee_per_kb_xmr plus priority_tiers[] each with {priority, fee_per_kb_atomic, fee_per_kb_xmr}. Monero has no EIP-1559 style fee market: blocks are never full, so the baseline tier normally confirms next block.
name: xmr_get_fee_rates
title: Xmr Get Fee Rates
